name: My Prince
source: This game will take place in a fantasy world. There will be two main characters: the prince (a feminine boy) and his fiancée, the duke's daughter. The main plot task will be to defeat the usurpers who have captured the royal castle. But it will not be possible to solve this problem quickly, and in the meantime the main characters will live in a certain free city.
translation: 本作以奇幻世界为舞台，共有两位主角：王子（一名容貌秀气的少年）与他的未婚妻——公爵千金。主线目标是击败占领王城的篡位者。然而这一难题无法在短时间内解决，在此期间，两位主角将在某座自由都市中共同生活。
